# Test photo sources
- `face0`–`face5.jpg` — crops of the sample photos shipped with `@vladmandic/face-api` (MIT, demo/sample*.jpg)
- `male0`–`male2.jpg` (v3.3) — crops of the screenshots shipped with `@vladmandic/human` 3.3.6 (MIT, assets/screenshot-faceid.jpg,
  screenshot-facedetect.jpg, screenshot-facematch.jpg); male2 is a small face pasted on a blurred copy of itself
- `noface.jpg` (v3.3) — drawn by script (sky, grass, a bench): a photo without a face
Used only by the automated tests; never published (only `public/` is deployed).
